command:
set -e; SERIAL=RFCT70L7E8J; state(){ adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys telephony.registry 2>/dev/null | sed -n 's/.*mCallState=\([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | head -n1 | tr -d ''; }; voice_block(){ adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys audio | sed -n '/- STREAM_VOICE_CALL:/,/Volume Group: AUDIO_STREAM_VOICE_CALL/p'; }; cleanup(){ python3 scripts/s22_call_control.py --serial "$SERIAL" hangup >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd audio adj-mute 0 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd audio adj-mute 8 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; }; trap cleanup EXIT; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd audio adj-mute 0; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd audio adj-mute 8 || true; PRE=$(voice_block); printf '%s
' "$PRE"; printf '%s
' "$PRE" | grep -q 'Muted: true'; printf '%s
' "$PRE" | grep -q 'streamVolume:0'; python3 scripts/s22_call_control.py --serial "$SERIAL" dial 510100100 >/dev/null; echo dial_requested=true; ACTIVE=0; for i in $(seq 1 40); do S=$(state); echo live_call_state=$S; if [ "$S" = "2" ]; then ACTIVE=1; break; fi; sleep 1; done; test "$ACTIVE" = "1"; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd audio adj-mute 0; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd audio adj-mute 8 || true; ACTIVE_AUDIO=$(voice_block); printf '%s
' "$ACTIVE_AUDIO"; printf '%s
' "$ACTIVE_AUDIO" | grep -q 'Muted: true'; printf '%s
' "$ACTIVE_AUDIO" | grep -q 'streamVolume:0'; printf '%s
' "$ACTIVE_AUDIO" | grep -q 'Devices: earpiece(1)'; echo silent_audio_guard_active=true; adb -s "$SERIAL" logcat -c; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell am force-stop pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge; START=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell am start -W -n pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge/.DiagnosticProbeActivity --ez run_shizuku_endurance_probe true 2>&1); printf '%s
' "$START"; printf '%s
' "$START" | grep -q 'Status: ok'; sleep 36; LOG=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" logcat -d -v brief -s AiCallBridge:I '*:S'); printf '%s
' "$LOG"; printf '%s
' "$LOG" | grep -q 'shizuku_endurance_probe_start=true'; printf '%s
' "$LOG" | grep -q 'probe=shizuku-user-service-endurance-v1'; printf '%s
' "$LOG" | grep -q 'service_uid=2000'; printf '%s
' "$LOG" | grep -q 'active_after_start=true'; printf '%s
' "$LOG" | grep -q 'all_heartbeats_ok=true'; printf '%s
' "$LOG" | grep -q 'active_throughout=true'; printf '%s
' "$LOG" | grep -q 'duration_ok=true'; printf '%s
' "$LOG" | grep -Eq 'downlink_bytes_read=[1-9][0-9]*'; printf '%s
' "$LOG" | grep -Eq 'uplink_bytes_written=[1-9][0-9]*'; printf '%s
' "$LOG" | grep -q 'active_before_abort=true'; printf '%s
' "$LOG" | grep -q 'heartbeat_before_abort=true'; printf '%s
' "$LOG" | grep -q 'threads_stopped=true'; printf '%s
' "$LOG" | grep -q 'prepared_after_abort=false'; printf '%s
' "$LOG" | grep -q 'active_after_abort=false'; printf '%s
' "$LOG" | grep -q 'heartbeat_after_abort=false'; printf '%s
' "$LOG" | grep -q 'privileged_uid=true'; printf '%s
' "$LOG" | grep -q 'endurance_ok=true'; cleanup; trap - EXIT; test "$(state)" = "0"; echo phase2_m3_endurance30_silent_green=true
